name: subjects
description: Browse the North Macedonia State Statistical Office (MakStat) PxWeb subject tree under the /MakStat database. Empty path returns top-level folders (type 'l'); drill with sub-paths to reach tables (type 't', '.px' suffix). Returns folder/table list for the given path.

path.description: Sub-path under /MakStat/ (default empty = root, returns top-level folders).

name: table_meta
description: Fetch dimension definitions and valid coded values for a MakStat PxWeb table. Path must end in the '.px' table id (e.g. 'Naselenie/VencaniRazvedeni/280_VitStat_Brak_voz_ml.px'). Returns dimensions with their codes and value lists — use these to build the selection body for query_table.

name: query_table
description: POST a PxWeb query to a MakStat (North Macedonia statistics) table and return observations as json-stat2. body must be {query:[{code, selection:{filter,values}}], response:{format:'json-stat2'}}. PxWeb enforces a cell-count limit — narrow each dimension's values using codes from table_meta to avoid rejection.
